items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Andy Morris had to work with the band with him though.

ctx.x: Did you ever work in the same band with Sidney Bean? No, no, no.
I just wanted you to mention him. No, I don't work with him. Andy Morris had to work with the band with him though. What about Lee Collins, you ever work with him?
Yeah, I work with Lee, yeah, yeah. I work with Lee, but two, but three years ago, in New York, at the Jazz Foundation at the, at the Town Club.
